_about: How to fill in each ballot paper, by election. The ONE source for any card, caption, reply or site text that tells people how to vote. Copy the 'say' wording exactly. Never write a rule from memory. Each entry records where it came from and when it was checked; an entry with verified=false must not be published until someone checks it against the official source.

lower_house.name: Legislative Assembly
lower_house.rule: number every box in the order of your choice
lower_house.say: Lower house: number every box, in any order you like.

upper_house.name: Legislative Council
upper_house.rule: above the line: number at least 5 boxes (groups); OR below the line: number at least 5 boxes (candidates); not both. No group voting tickets.
upper_house.say: Upper house: number at least 5 boxes above the line, or at least 5 below.
upper_house.say_short: Upper house: at least 5 above the line, or 5 below.

vic2026.notes: Changed by the 2026 amendments to the Electoral Act 2002. A single 1 above the line is INFORMAL in 2026.
informal_if: ticks, crosses or any other symbol in the boxes
mistakes: Made a mistake? Cross it out and write the correct number next to it.
Or hand the ballot paper back to election staff and ask for a new one.
upper_house_detail: Above the line: number at least 5 boxes, and write no numbers below the line.
Below the line: number at least 5 boxes, and write no numbers above the line.

vic2022.source: Atlas site text (group voting tickets: a single 1 above the line let the group decide preferences). Below-the-line minimum still to be confirmed from a VEC source.

upper_house.rule: a 1 above the line (group voting ticket) or number below the line (minimum to be confirmed)

vic2022.notes: Historical only: never give this as advice for 2026.

federal.notes: Add House and Senate rules from the AEC before any federal card or reply mentions them.
